description: This file implements an Angular service called AuthService that manages user authentication state, including token handling, user information, and navigation upon logout.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: An Angular service that manages authentication state, token storage, user information, and navigation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the authentication service by attempting to fetch and set the current user based on stored token.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Stores the authentication token in local storage and notifies subscribers of auth changes.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored authentication token from local storage.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user object or null.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the current user object and notifies subscribers of auth changes.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the token, resets user state, notifies subscribers, and navigates to the login page.
